observations: Two gas cylinders are shown side-by-side in photo 0 and 1.
The orange cylinder on the left has a brass valve and a black mesh pattern on the lower body.
The white cylinder on the right has a brass valve and a white plastic handle.
Both cylinders have a small hole at the base, likely for a pressure gauge.
The background shows other gas cylinders and a red metal stand.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI HITECH TECHNOLOGIES' and 'REDMI 12 | HITECH NIG LTD' are visible.

claims.evidence: The cylinders appear clean in the photos, but usage history cannot be confirmed remotely.
The weight stamp on the cylinder is not visible in the provided photos.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak, the valve is new.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The cylinders may be expired or past their re-test date.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacture or expiry date stamped on the metal shroud or handle.

risks.risk: The valve may be faulty or leaking.
risks.proof: A video showing a soap bubble test on the valve while the cylinder is held under water.

risks.risk: The cylinders may be empty or contain a different gas than LPG.
risks.proof: A photo of the weight stamp on the shroud showing the current weight.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the weight stamp on the shroud to confirm the current weight.
Photo of the expiry or manufacture date stamped on the cylinder shroud.
Video of a soap bubble test on the valve.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
